interpretation_limits: No selection changes were made after seeing held-out outcomes.
The primary macro's low RMSE accompanies much lower participation; it is not an overall success.
Bid/rejection diagnostics describe the observed policy; they do not prove that repricing alone fixes the hierarchy.
Supplemental 26h peaks do not replace registered 24h stress metrics.
These are isolated 26h episodes, not continuous multi-day operation; adjacent dates can overlap in their service/recovery windows.
The five seeds repeat across dates; sample SD is descriptive, not evidence of 15 independent calendar conditions.
After guiding further development, these peak dates cannot again be called an untouched test set.
